patch:
@@ -72,7 +72,7 @@ jobs:
         id: fast-tests
         run: |
           set -o pipefail
-          racket scripts/run-tests.rkt --suite fast --timeout 300 --record-gate-evidence 2>&1 | tee test-output.log
+          racket scripts/run-tests.rkt --suite fast --timeout 300 --record-gate-evidence --json-out test-results-release.json 2>&1 | tee test-output.log
 
       - name: Record gate evidence (arch)
         run: |
@@ -105,6 +105,12 @@ jobs:
           echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
           grep -A 4 'FAILURE\|ERROR\|FAILED\|TIMEOUT' test-output.log release-readiness.log >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY || true
           echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
+          # BUG-0065: CI-only failures need per-file rackunit detail; the
+          # runner already captures it — persist the failing files' output.
+          if [ -f test-results-release.json ]; then
+            echo "## Per-file failure output" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
+            jq -r '.files[] | select(.category != "PASS") | "### \(.path) [\(.category)]\n```\n\(.output)\n```"' test-results-release.json >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY 2>/dev/null || true
+          fi
 
       - name: Upload test log
         if: always()
@@ -114,6 +120,7 @@ jobs:
           path: |
             test-output.log
             release-readiness.log
+            test-results-release.json
           retention-days: 7
 
   # ── Extract version from tag ──

@@ -297,8 +297,8 @@ q/
 | Test files | 1468 |
 | Source modules | 866 |
 | Source lines | 174049 |
-| Test lines | 264300 |
-| Test assertions | 40304 |
+| Test lines | 264309 |
+| Test assertions | 40307 |
 | Tests passing | 5835+ | `racket scripts/run-tests.rkt` results |
 
 > _These metrics are generated by `racket scripts/metrics.rkt`. Do not edit manually._

@@ -102,6 +102,15 @@
   (define content (read-release-yml))
   (check-true (string-contains? content "needs: test") "prepare job must depend on test"))
 
+(test-case "release.yml test job retains per-file failure diagnostics (BUG-0065)"
+  (define content (read-release-yml))
+  (check-true (string-contains? content "--json-out test-results-release.json")
+              "fast suite must write per-file JSON results so CI-only failures are diagnosable")
+  (check-true (string-contains? content "test-results-release.json")
+              "results JSON must be referenced by upload/summary steps")
+  (check-true (string-contains? content "Per-file failure output")
+              "failure summary must include per-file failure output"))
+
 (test-case "release.yml release-core depends on prepare"
   (define content (read-release-yml))
   (check-true (string-contains? content "needs: prepare") "release-core must depend on prepare"))
